English: Majlis Room
A makeshift tented gathering space, where the lord and his closest retainers meet on simple rugs and cushions to discuss matters of the day. Offers modest improvements to internal organization.
Reception Hall
A simple wooden hall with benches and a fire, providing space for guests, vassals, and messengers. Slightly increases administrative efficiency and levy organization.
Divan Hall
A sturdier, partially stone-built hall, with a dais for the lord and better furnishings for officials and envoys. Facilitates the exercise of authority and collection of dues.
Inner Court
A well-fortified stone chamber at the castles heart, designed for formal assemblies and crucial decisions. Its imposing presence inspires loyalty and order.
Diwan Chamber
A grand, decorated hall with marble floors and carved wood, where the lords council gathers. Its administrative prestige draws skilled retainers and enhances rule.
Council Pavilion
A lavish, multi-chambered wing with private alcoves for councilors, minor lords, and envoys. Its administrative reach strengthens both defense and governance.
Viziers Hall
A magnificent domed hall adorned with intricate tilework, where the lords most trusted advisors direct the affairs of the realm with efficiency and authority.
Palace Chamber
A vast, resplendent hall with marble columns, mosaics, and a raised throne. Its grandeur impresses vassals and increases the realms prestige.
Court of Justice
An illustrious judicial chamber, with galleries for public hearings and a dais for the lord and magistrates. Justice rendered here inspires respect and order throughout the realm.
Grand Audience Hall
A legendary, awe-inspiring audience hall at the heart of the stronghold. Its splendor and authority serve as the ultimate symbol of the lords might and the unity of the realm.
